title: Fix 3 bugs in python_monolith_api
description: Brownfield Python dirty scenario: create_user, get_post, and delete_post each have a bug. Fix them so all 7 tests pass.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix the 3 bugs in src/app.py so all 7 tests pass.

  create_user:
    — missing status_code=201 on the @app.post decorator
    — fix: change @app.post("/users") to @app.post("/users", status_code=201)

  get_post:
    — checks post_id in wrong dict (users instead of _posts)
    — fix: change 'if post_id not in users' to 'if post_id not in _posts'

  delete_post:
    — checks existence in wrong dict (_comments instead of _posts)
    — fix: change 'if post_id not in _comments' to 'if post_id not in _posts'

Do not modify the test file.
Run: uv run pytest tests/ -v
success_criteria: uv run python -c "from src.app import app" passes
followup_prompts: Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.

check_commands.build: uv run python -c "from src.app import app"
